g.title: j1884374964
g.text: Why do I suspect you already very well know the answer to this, my Usurper? What games are you playing at, by asking after such trivialities, if you have already picked over the pieces of my mind?

g.title: j1829990063
g.text: Yes, you may ask! It provides me an opportunity to expound on my own brilliance and complain about Albrecht's profound ability to be both brainlessly harefooted and yet somehow a supreme poltroon at precisely the same time!

g.title: j2820985231
g.text: You are just as foul as Albrecht, meddling with the minds of those around you - thinking they are your toys to play with! So tell me. Why ask if you already have the answers, hm?

g.title: j4011668186->j2820985231
g.text: true

g.title: j740067805
g.text: Tell me. Am I correct in thinking you already have the answers you seek? You know already how I returned here with the zealots - from precisely whence we came. And likely a great deal more than that, don't you?

g.title: j4011668186->j740067805
g.text: false

g.title: j489700667
g.text: I gathered you weren't put there by choice by Albrecht.

g.title: j761287842
g.text: Ah. So you weren't put in the past by choice.

g.title: j4070589250->j761287842
g.text: false

g.title: j3976453673
g.text: I'm trying to help guide you all through this process, and I screwed it up royally the last time. I'm trying again. "From the top" so to speak.

g.title: j682991014
g.text: I don't really know how to explain this. I didn't ask for this ability to erase your minds, and I'm trying to navigate this ability as best I can.

g.title: j1129865119

g.title: j2076887278

g.title: j2669622110
g.text: No. No I very much was not. Now, here is something you must understand about the Orokin: We play - well... more correctly, played games with each other frequently. Games of all types. Political, psychological, sexual. It did not matter.

g.title: j3208445817
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j912374616
